name: Aarti Pharmalabs Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2019, Aarti Pharmalabs Ltd is a manufacturer of Pharmaceuticals and Nutraceuticals[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Aarti Pharmalabs Limited (APL), formerly known as Aarti Organics, was established in 1984 as a WOS of Aarti Industries Limited. Got demerged in Oct,22 into a separately listed entity. Co. is an internationally recognized manufacturer of generic API & Intermediates, Xanthine derivatives, and offers CDMO/CMO services. The company has 6 manufacturing plants and 3 R&D centres.

cons: Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -0.84%
